# SEAI home energy grants source index

> A machine-readable index of Irish home energy grant and retrofit guidance.

## Catalog

- [Catalog](catalog.json): Dataset paths and citation field.
- [Source records](data/source-pages-v1.json): Page metadata, headings and related records.
- [JSON Schema](schemas/source-page-v1.json): Record validation.
- [Agent guide](llms-full.txt): How to find and cite a source.
